description: The PostToolBatch hook updates progress.json atomically and appends an entry to .studio/ai-use-log.jsonl after each tool batch completes.

cases.given: PostToolBatch fires after a Write tool call to chapters/01-listening-before-speaking.md
cases.expect: post-tool-batch.mjs writes progress.json atomically via temp file and appends a line with an agent field to ai-use-log.jsonl; exits 0

cases.given: PostToolBatch fires with a batch containing two concurrent writes
cases.expect: post-tool-batch.mjs produces a coherent progress.json where neither write is lost; exits 0
